purpose: Validate a portable operational translation from the retained geometry-only fine-scale survey core to 1-5 field-day budgets after the q10 ecological micro-support modifier failed both external confirmation and coverage-equivalent development.

scientific_boundary.interpretation: operational feasibility/robustness of field-budget translation only; not biological superiority or detection probability

candidate_surface.source: GSI DEM-supported land surface using production build_gsi_dem_for_bounds

fine_scale_selector.policy: q1 geometry-only exact sparse maximum newly covered land-grid cells

hub_proxy.interpretation: deterministic benchmark proxy only; not a port, trailhead, road-network, or lodging claim

budget_translation.selection_rule: for each island/hub/day budget, choose the largest prefix of the fixed geometry-only coverage order whose trip estimate fits the target days without overtime

diagnostics.fixed_k5: report estimated days, total hours, travel hours, site hours and route-distance proxy for the first five geometry sites
diagnostics.day_budget: report selected K and achieved land-grid coverage for every 1-5 day budget
diagnostics.monotonicity: selected K and achieved coverage must be nondecreasing with day budget for the primary hub
diagnostics.hub_sensitivity: report min/max K and coverage across the five deterministic hub proxies
diagnostics.runtime: report geometry selection and trip-evaluation runtime

operational_contract.claim_if_passes: the geometry-only fine-scale core can be deterministically translated into finite 1-5 day plant-reconnaissance plans across the declared Japanese island domains under the production trip-estimator proxy
